summary: Validates this, the sub-object pointer at this+0x1C, and the guard pointers at this+0x20 and this+0x24; returns -2 if any is null. Then resets multiple fields on this (offsets 0x8, 0x14, 0x18 to 0; 0x2C to 2; 0x30 to 1) and on the sub-object (v1[5] to 0, v1[4] from v1[2], v1[6] clamped to >= 0, v1[1] set to 113 or 42 depending on whether v1[6] is non-zero, and byte at v1+30 to 0). Finally calls UIElementInitialization(v1) and sub_536260(v1) and returns 0.

operations.description: Guard on this being non-null; return -2 when this is null.
Load the sub-object pointer v1 from this+0x1C.
Guard on v1, this+0x20 and this+0x24 all being non-null; return -2 if any is null.
Reset this fields to 0: this+0x14, this+0x8 and this+0x18.
Set the state field at this+0x2C to 2.
Save v2 = v1[2], then reset sub-object fields: v1[5] = 0 and v1[4] = v2.
Guard on v1[6] (this+0x34) being negative; clamp it to 0 when (int)v1[6] < 0.
Set sub-object field v1[1] to 113 when v1[6] (this+0x34) is non-zero, otherwise to 42.
Set the flag field at this+0x30 to 1.
Clear the byte at sub-object offset 30 (this+0x3A) to 0.
Call UIElementInitialization(v1) to initialize the sub-object.
Call sub_536260(v1) for post-init processing on the sub-object.
Return 0 on successful initialization (or -2 on any null-check failure).
Invoked by sub_535C10 (0x00535C10) on the frame path.
